seoTitle: How to Make a Gantt Chart in Asana Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to build a Gantt chart in Asana using the Timeline view in 2026, adding dates, dependencies, and milestones to visualize your schedule.
intro: Asana's Timeline view functions as its built-in Gantt chart, letting you visualize task schedules, dependencies, and milestones without any add-ons. This guide covers enabling Timeline view, adding tasks with dates, and linking dependent work so your team can see the full project flow at a glance.

steps.heading: Enable the Timeline view
steps.body: Open a new or existing project and select the Timeline view tab to switch into the Gantt-style layout.

steps.heading: Add tasks with start and due dates
steps.body: Add tasks with specific start and due dates so visual bars automatically generate on the Timeline canvas.

steps.heading: Link dependent tasks
steps.body: Create task dependencies to show sequential workflow chains and highlight where bottlenecks could occur.

steps.heading: Set milestones
steps.body: Convert key tasks into milestones so critical checkpoints stand out clearly on the schedule.

steps.heading: Adjust and share the schedule
steps.body: Use drag-and-drop to reschedule work or extend durations, zoom controls to manage the timeline scale, and share the view with stakeholders.

faq.question: Is Timeline view available on Asana's free plan?
faq.answer: Timeline view is typically included on paid Asana tiers, so check your current plan if the tab isn't visible on your project.

faq.question: Can I drag tasks to change their dates directly on the chart?
faq.answer: Yes, you can drag task bars on the Timeline canvas to instantly reschedule start and due dates.

faq.question: How do dependencies affect the Gantt chart?
faq.answer: Linking tasks as dependencies draws a visual connector between them and can flag scheduling conflicts if a predecessor task runs late.

faq.question: Can I turn a regular task into a milestone?
faq.answer: Yes, any task can be converted into a milestone to mark it as a key checkpoint on the Timeline.
